THE_RULE_THAT_MATTERS_MOST.why: the PTOPD01 record lost 17 checker findings because the return was acted on before it was written to an artefact. The raw return is written to TLMR01/review/TLMR01_CHECKER_RAW.txt, byte for byte, with its sha256 and byte count published, BEFORE a single finding is read for action.

WHAT_THE_CHECKER_IS_GIVEN: the frozen pre-run artefacts and the master freeze
the code of every TLMR01 module
the analysis output and the per-world results
the raw archives, and the offline reader with which to re-derive anything it doubts
WHAT_THE_CHECKER_IS_ASKED: does the analysis compute what the frozen definitions say it computes
is any threshold, unit, denominator or ordering different from the one frozen before world 1
is any quantity presented as DIRECTLY_MEASURED that does not meet the declared support rule
is any interval, clustering correction or zero-numerator bound computed wrongly
is any claim in the report stronger than the claim ceiling permits
is any forbidden claim made, including in denial
is any gate vacuous — incapable of returning a value other than the one it returned
is the disposition the one the frozen cascade returns for these numbers

ADJUDICATION.rule: every finding is adjudicated exactly once, in writing, with an explicit verdict of UPHELD, PARTIALLY_UPHELD or REJECTED and a stated reason. A finding is never silently dropped and never re-litigated in a second pass.
ADJUDICATION.what_may_change_after_a_finding: the REPORT and the DESCRIPTION may be corrected. The frozen rules, thresholds, denominators and the disposition logic may not. If a finding shows the analysis violated a frozen rule, the analysis is corrected to obey that rule — which is not a repair of the science but the removal of a departure from it — and the correction is published with the finding that caused it.
